description.value: Maple Ridge Cycle is a family-owned bicycle shop that has served the Fraser Valley since 1967, making it one of BC's longest-established bike shops. The shop handles sales and repairs across all disciplines — MTB, road, gravel, BMX, e-bikes, and kids' bikes — and services any bike regardless of where it was purchased. It is an authorized Kona Bikes and SE Bicycles dealer and is actively involved in local cycling events such as the Ridge Meadow BMX racing series.
